prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. ONE original square premium painterly naturalistic mythological illustration of KRISHNA respectfully depicted as the compassionate protector lifting GOVARDHAN HILL. Spectacular low camera from ground, Krishna a monumental youthful divine man dominates foreground, dark BLUE-BLACK skin, one head, TWO eyes, exactly TWO arms and TWO legs. Serene authoritative expression, dark hair bearing a plainly readable single peacock feather. Elegant fully opaque YELLOW traditional robe covers his entire chest, waist and legs, original modest drapery. His left arm stretches high: ONE hand visibly touches and UPHOLDS the underside of an enormous suspended rocky HILL, effortlessly as if in sport. The hill's broad rocky roof spans most of the top of the square, with grass and tiny trees on its summit; clear visible gap between hill and ground. His other hand extends compassionately downward. Krishna's whole body, the supporting hand and physical contact must stay readable. Several very small cattle sheltered near distant tree roots beneath the hill reinforce scale; no other gods or monsters. Torrential rain cascades outside the shelter in the distance while dry ground under the hill remains safe, a huge rain curtain with soft daylight breaking beneath the overhang. This depicts his seven-day Govardhan protection; do not make rain emerge from Krishna. Warm reflected light on yellow silk contrasts with the storm; divine dignity through light and scale, NO invented magic rings or luminous body effects. Rich detailed brushwork, original respectful Hindu illustration, powerful monumental action rather than a portrait. No extra heads/arms, wings, weapon, flame, laser, copied game/film/anime/comic design, bare torso, nudity, gore, text, inscriptions, watermark, logo or frame. ONE square image at least 1024 by 1024.

Hill lifted clear of ground with a protected dry shelter, small cattle and storm rain beyond.

aura: No invented emitted aura. Monumental physical mountain-lifting and external deluge follow c31.
artistic_choices: Framing, garment arrangement, villagers and cattle in the pastoral Gokula setting and rain composition are editorial staging of c31; no emitted magic effect.

visual_review.notes: Main agent viewed native PNG directly: one youthful dark blue-black Krishna with a peacock feather and fully opaque yellow garments; two arms and two bare feet visible. One raised hand visibly supports the underside of Govardhan while his other hand extends toward the protected community and cattle. Storm rain falls beyond the hill and dry shelter; rain belongs to the deluge sent by Indra, not an invented Krishna power (c05/c18/c31). Strong low-angle monumental scale, no visible text, watermark, extra limbs or nudity. Raised palm/fingers partly occluded at rock contact; tiny background people are not individually inspectable.

presentation_revision_history.prompt: ONE square premium painterly naturalistic mythological education illustration of KRISHNA, respectful Hindu iconography. One radiant dignified youthful living deity with BLUE-BLACK skin, one head exactly two arms, two legs, yellow opaque robe, peacock feather in dark hair (krishna-c24). He holds a whole immense ROCKY GOVARDHAN HILL aloft with ONE raised hand effortlessly like a roof, clearly separated from ground and visibly supported by his palm (c05,c18,c31); other hand open protective gesture. Under the great overhanging hill, tiny distant cowherd villagers and cattle shelter safely from driving torrents of rain outside; seven-day deluge story c31. Low camera, figure dominates foreground with serene compassionate power amid epic storm, dramatic natural light glints on lifted wet rock, painterly rich detail. No generic energy ribbons, emitted fire, extra heads/arms, modern film/game/anime designs, gore, text, labels, logos, border or watermark. Modest opaque drapery covers torso and lower body, original scene rather than copying historical painting.

artistic_changes: Fully opaque torso coverage and original yellow drapery are modest clothing choices; low viewpoint, small cattle, warm reflected daylight and broad overhang express scale.
